about: Measured by LiveViewsDataParityTest on the real game (ADR 0120 D9, B607): what each target's server did with the files of fixtures/live-views. loot, mined, killed: tables rolled 10000 times by loot insert; items are counts of rolls by the total of each item key (the item id, and worn=<damage in twentieths of the durability> when damaged); enchantments are rolls with each id=level on a stack. exploded: 2000 explosions of the block. predicates: tests and yes answers by execute if predicate. modifiers: the stack before and after item modify. tags: members as the registry resolved them (null when the tag did not load). functions: what a mock player and the box at its spot (x 0 to 5, y 0 to 2, z -1 to 1) held after the run. Every case has the situation it was measured in, in @msm/sim's Situation shape. Rates may differ by 2 points (3 for explosions) or five standard deviations of the difference, whichever is larger. Rewritten by the parity build's liveViewsParity task with -PupdateLiveViewsParity; never edited by hand.
